exposure: length of intensive care unit (ICU) stay
cohort: The study included 337 preterm infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit in King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Center in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, who met ROP screening criteria from March 2016 to March 2021.
finding: The incidence of ROP was 53.7%, with male sex, multifetal gestations leading to low birth weight, and complicated neonatal courses (NEC, Chronic Lung Disease, IVH) being associated with a high incidence of ROP.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the main mode of delivery in 80.5% of the sample, but no specific finding linking it to ROP incidence was explicitly stated as a primary outcome of this study.
followup_time: The number of ROP follow-up ranged between 2 and 25 visits either in the NICU or in the eye clinic following their discharge, but no overall study duration post-birth is explicitly mentioned for the last observation.
